name: loom-discord
description: loom's Discord venue adapter: each agent's own bot, its messages routed to the agent and handed to loom's deliver, and the agent's replies posted as that bot

loom.name: discord
loom.label: Discord
loom.description: Discord as a venue: each agent's own bot; a message is routed (a mention, the channel's primary, the gates) and delivered to the agent, and its replies post as that bot.

options.label: Shadow: route and log, deliver nothing, post nothing
Live: deliver to loom, post replies

settings.name: DISCORD_BOTS
settings.label: Each agent's bot
settings.hint: JSON: agent to the secret its bot token comes from, like {"kit": "kit-discord-token"}; the secrets piece's policy must allow that agent

settings.name: DISCORD_DATA
settings.label: Where its cursors and logs are kept

settings.name: DISCORD_TOKEN_FILE
settings.label: This piece's own token, to deliver with (live)
settings.hint: a file holding a piece token of this piece's (loom token create --piece discord/<name>)

settings.name: DISCORD_LOOM_URL
settings.label: loom's address, as this machine reaches it

settings.name: DISCORD_ROUTES_COMMAND
settings.label: How an agent's route map is read
settings.hint: a JSON argv printing {"doc": …}, {agent} filled in; default ["loom", "shuttle", "routes", "--agent", "{agent}", "--json"]

settings.name: DISCORD_GATES_COMMAND
settings.label: How an agent's gates are read
settings.hint: a JSON argv printing {"doc": …}, {agent} filled in; default the runtime's ["loom", "runtime", "gates", "people", "--agent", "{agent}", "--json"]
